defect: R49 used workspace, callsite and request payload digest as a uniqueness key. That collapses legitimate later executions of the same request and its idempotent replay compared too few immutable fields.
correction: each exchange and lifecycle event receives a stable operation idempotency digest
the same request payload under a different operation identity creates a distinct receipt
an exact retry with the same operation identity converges on the first receipt or event even if the caller proposes a new UUID
a retry that changes control evidence, minimisation evidence, time or any other immutable field fails closed
request payload digest remains evidence about content identity but is no longer operation identity
next_gate: Build public-source admission as R52, then compose admitted R50 queries with corrected R51 receipts.
